Title: Retirement: MICROSOFT AZURE OPERATED BY 21VIANET - Action required to migrate to Azure China North 3 region by July 1, 2026 due to China North 1 and China East 1 region retirement

Body.Content:
Over the past decade, Microsoft Azure operated by 21Vianet (Azure in China) has been expanding the Azure cloud infrastructure in China, demonstrating long-term investment in the market. Azure in China is committed to building a compliant, flexible, and innovative cloud platform to meet the unique needs of customers.   


As part of this commitment, Azure in China consistently evaluates opportunities to optimize the deployment of the cloud datacenter infrastructure to support customer’s critical work efficiently and in a modern, more secure and cost-effective manner. 


With this in mind, Azure in China announces the 2 first-generation regions, China North 1 and China East 1, will be retired on July 1, 2026, as the infrastructure of these regions does not support advanced Azure products and workloads.


Azure in China will continue to operate in multiple regions, such as China North 3, which provide enhanced capabilities to the China North 1 and China East 1 regions. As long as customer migrates out of these regions before July 1, 2026, this will not impact the ability to use Azure in China.


Beginning July 1, 2026, China North 1 and China East 1 regions will be retired, and customers will experience disruption in their services if they have not migrated their Azure resources from these two regions. 


To avoid disruptions to applications, customers are recommended to complete migration of their Azure resources by July 1, 2026. 

If you have questions, contact support.
